Schedule

  • August 10th - September 16th: Round Robin
  • September 17th - 18th: Playoffs

Format

  • 3 versus 3
  • League Stage
    • 2 groups of 6 teams
    • Round Robin, Pa4
    • Top 2 teams from each group advance to the Playoff Stage
    • Scoring
      1. 1 point per game win
      2. 1 extra point for winning the set
    • Tiebreakers
      1. Points
      2. Head-to-head
      3. Set wins
      4. Points of defeated opponents
      5. Bo1 decider
  • Playoff Stage
    • Single-elimination bracket
    • Semifinals are Bo5
    • Final is Bo7
